newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE COFFEE ENDS DOWN, HIT BY LIQUIDATION IN PM.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE COFFEE ENDS DOWN, HIT BY LIQUIDATION IN PM.

text.p: LIFFE coffee ended lower after taking a hit in the final stages from pre-weekend long liquidation, traders said.
"There's no buying in London," one trader said. "The industry's leaving it alone," he said, citing the holidays and good coverage on robustas for a lack of industry interest.
By the close, September was $29 lower at $1,615 on volume of 2,006 lots of the total 3,184.
"There's plenty of availability of robusta," the trader said.
A lower New York helped London down, with a sharp decline in the September contract as speculators took profits on Thursday's rally.
